wilds.name: Wild
wilds.behavior:
The wild symbol substitutes for any symbol except
 other wild symbols, the bomb, the nest, bonus symbol,
 free drops symbol, and the super bonus symbol.

wilds.name: Multiplier Wild
wilds.behavior:
The multiplier wild symbol substitutes for any symbol
 except other wild symbols, the bonus symbol, free
 drops symbol, and the super bonus symbol. It also has
 a multiplier that is multiplied by the winning amount for
 all winning clusters where the multiplier wild is
 included.

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior:
Three or more bonus symbols trigger the bonus game
 with free drops.

scatters.name: Super Bonus
scatters.behavior:
The super bonus symbol in combination with two or
 more bonus symbols trigger the super bonus game
 with free drops.

multipliers.name: Multiplier Wild
multipliers.behavior:
The multiplier wild symbol substitutes for any symbol
 except other wild symbols, the bonus symbol, free
 drops symbol, and the super bonus symbol. It also has
 a multiplier that is multiplied by the winning amount for
 all winning clusters where the multiplier wild is
 included.

multipliers.name: Global Multiplier
multipliers.behavior:
The global multiplier that increase when
Pirots collect symbols, the Pirot features that consist of the bomb, the feature
chest, the big symbol drop and Charlie who can randomly release a bomb,
the different wild symbols and the big symbols. The wild symbols come in
two flavours; regular wild and the multiplier wild. The big symbols go up to
four by four in size.

collectors.name: Pirot bird collection
collectors.behavior:
From the game grid, the birds can collect vertically and
 horizontally adjacent symbols of the same color as the
 bird. The birds do not collect feature symbols or wilds.
 The free drops symbol adds additional free drops in
 conjunction with a bonus game trigger or when it
 appears in an ongoing bonus game.

specials.name: Bomb
specials.behavior:
The bomb symbol explodes at the end of the game
 round. It removes all symbols, except feature symbols,
 in close proximity of it, resulting in a redrop to fill empty
 symbol positions. The explosion also expands the
 game grid, up to a maximum of 7 rows by 7 columns.

specials.name: Nest
specials.behavior:
The nest allows a bird to move down to the game grid.
 From the game grid, the birds can collect vertically and
 horizontally adjacent symbols of the same color as the
 bird. The birds do not collect feature symbols or wilds.

specials.name: Feature Chest
specials.behavior:
The feature chest triggers a release of a number of
 symbols that can be either wild, multiplier wild, bomb,
 nest, free drop, bonus or super bonus symbols.

base_game_loop.summary:

 vertically or horizontally connected.. Avalanche/tumble after wins. Bonus modes: Bonus, Super Bonus. Round ends on win cap if reached.

spaces.

phases.name: End-of-drop features

Game rules
 Pirots X is a 5 reel, 5 row slot with dropping symbols and cluster wins.
 The game can expand the game grid up to a maximum of 7 rows by 7
 columns.
 The minimum bet is € 0.20, and the maximum bet is € 100.00.
 Each bet is 100 coins.
 A winning cluster consists of 5 or more identical symbols which are either
 vertically or horizontally connected. Only the largest cluster of the
 connected identical symbols is paid out.
 A game round starts on the selected bet level when the player hits the
 Spin button.
 The game can be played automatically by activating Auto Spin. Hold
 down the Spin button or use the Auto Spin button to set the number of
 game rounds to be played automatically.
